title: What If Everyone Had a Secret Rating for You?
description:
Alex wakes up one morning with a strange new ability: he can see how much everyone secretly likes him, rated from 1 to 10.

His crush gives him a brutal 2/10, but the most beautiful and popular girl at school secretly rates him a perfect 10/10.

Things get even crazier when everyone's secret ratings become public, exposing fake friendships, jealous crushes, and relationships nobody expected.

#WhatIf #Animation #ConChaser

title: What If Everyone Had to Follow Their Own Dating Standards?
description:
Alex's girlfriend wants a traditional man who pays every bill, cooks, cleans, and treats her like a queen. But when it comes to her own responsibilities, she wants none of them.

Everything changes when Alex gains the power to force everyone to follow the same dating standards they demand from others.

Suddenly, relationships turn into complete chaos, and everyone gets a taste of their own expectations. But Alex is about to discover that his own standards aren't so perfect either.

#WhatIf #Animation #DatingStandards #ConChaser

title: What If You Could See Everyone's Dating Standards?
description:
Alex suddenly gains the ability to see everyone's dating standards floating above their heads.

From girls demanding rich, 6'5" muscular boyfriends to guys with ridiculous expectations, the entire school is full of unrealistic demands.

But when Alex starts exposing everyone's standards, he discovers something embarrassing about himself. And when the perfect guy finally shows up, someone is about to get a serious reality check.

#WhatIf #Animation #DatingStandards #ConChaser

title: What If You Could Rent Superpowers for $1 an Hour?
description:
What if you could rent any superpower for just $1 an hour?

Alex discovers a mysterious app that lets him buy flight, invisibility, super strength, teleportation, and even the ability to freeze time.

At first, it seems like the greatest deal ever. But when his flight subscription expires thousands of feet above the city, Alex discovers that superpowers come with some pretty dangerous terms and conditions.

#WhatIf #Animation #Superpowers #ConChaser

title: What If Every Insult Made You More Attractive?
description:
What if every insult actually made you better?

Alex discovers that whenever someone makes fun of him, his biggest weaknesses get fixed. Too short? He grows taller. Bad haircut? Instantly upgraded. Broke? Suddenly a millionaire.

At first, getting bullied feels like winning the lottery. But the more perfect Alex becomes, the more things start going wrong.

#WhatIf #Animation #ConChaser

title: What If Every Rejection Paid You $1,000?
description:
Alex gets rejected by his crush, but instead of heartbreak, he receives $1,000.

Soon, getting rejected becomes his favorite way to make money. But when he discovers a secret $1,000,000 reward, things get complicated.

What happens when the one thing making you rich is also keeping you from finding love?

#WhatIf #Animation #ConChaser

title: What If You Were Trapped in a Dating Simulator?
description:
Alex thought he'd hit the jackpot when he woke up in a world where three beautiful girls wanted to date him.

A vampire with jealousy issues, a princess who thinks money can buy everything, and a shy girl hiding a huge secret.

Sounds like the perfect fantasy, right? Well, Alex is about to find out that some games are much easier to enter than to escape.

#WhatIf #Animation #DatingSimulator #ConChaser

title: What If You Could See Everyone's Bank Balance?
description:
What if you could see exactly how much money everyone has?

Alex has just $12, while the quiet nerd nobody notices at school is secretly sitting on $48 million. Suddenly, everyone’s true financial situation is exposed, fake millionaires get embarrassed, and friendships change overnight.

But Alex is about to discover that having money and knowing who to trust are two very different things.

title: What If Everyone Could See Your Search History?
description:
What if everyone could suddenly see your entire search history? 💀

Alex's worst nightmare becomes reality when his most embarrassing searches appear above his head for everyone to see. And he's not the only one hiding secrets...

From hilarious school moments to unexpected betrayals and a shocking romantic twist, things are about to get completely out of control.

What's the ONE search you'd never want anyone to see? 😂

#WhatIf #Animation #ConChaser

title: What If Everyone Could Hear Your Thoughts?
description:
What if everyone could hear your thoughts? 💭

Imagine having absolutely no privacy inside your own head. Every embarrassing thought, every secret crush, and every awkward moment suddenly becomes everyone's business.

For Alex, one innocent family dinner turns into an absolute nightmare when his best friend's sister walks into the room...

Would you survive a day if everyone could hear your thoughts? 😂

#WhatIf #Animation #ConChaser

title: What If You Could See Who Talks Behind Your Back?
description:
What if you could see exactly who talks behind your back? 👀🔴

Alex suddenly gains the ability to see a red symbol above anyone who has been talking badly about him.

At first, it seems like the perfect superpower. He can finally expose fake friends, discover hidden jealousy, and find out who he can really trust.

But when even his closest friends start glowing red, things take an unexpected turn.

Would you want this ability?

#WhatIf #Animation #ConChaser

title: What If You Played GTA 6 Before Anyone Else?
description:
What if you were the person who leaked GTA 6? 🎮👀

Alex gets his hands on unreleased GTA 6 footage and decides to share it with the world. Within hours, the internet goes crazy, millions of people are watching, and Rockstar Games wants answers.

But when money, fame, and legal trouble enter the picture, things quickly spiral out of control.

Inspired by the Cyberleek controversy, this animated story combines reported events with fictional characters and dramatized scenes.

Would you risk everything to leak GTA 6?

#GTA6 #WhatIf #ConChaser

title: What If You Could See Who Finds You Attractive?
description:
What if you could instantly see who finds you attractive? 👀❤️

Alex suddenly gains the ability to see a YES or NO above everyone's head, revealing whether they're attracted to the person they're looking at.

At first, it seems like the ultimate superpower. No more guessing, no more rejection, and no more wondering if your crush likes you.

But when Alex starts chasing every YES, he risks losing the one person who genuinely cares about him.

Would you want this ability?

#WhatIf #Animation #ConChaser

title: What If You Could See Who Will Become Famous?
description:
What if you could see how famous everyone will become?

Alex discovers that Maya, the quiet girl everyone bullies at school, is destined to have 250 million followers.

He decides to help her become famous, but years later, she reveals a secret that changes everything.

Would you want to know who's going to become famous? 👀

#WhatIf #Animation #ConChaser

title: Imagine If You Could See Everyone's IQ
description:
What if you could see exactly how smart everyone around you is?

Alex studies harder than anyone, yet his IQ is only 99. Meanwhile, his classmate Ryan has an IQ of 148 and barely even tries.

But when their numbers start changing, Alex discovers that being the smartest person in the room isn't always what it seems.

Would you want to see everyone's IQ? 👀

#WhatIf #Animation #ConChaser

title: What If You Could See Who the Antichrist Is?
description:
What if you could see who the Antichrist is?

When Alex discovers a mysterious 666 above an innocent orphan's head, he faces an impossible choice. Is the boy destined to become evil, or can love, faith, and free will change his future?

A story about destiny, redemption, and the power of never giving up on someone.

title: What If You Could See How Many Lives Everyone Has Saved?
description:
What if you could see how many lives every person has saved? 👀

Some people have saved hundreds. Others haven't saved a single one. But when Alex discovers an ordinary school janitor with **999+ lives saved**, he uncovers a story nobody expected.

Sometimes the biggest heroes are the ones nobody notices.

🔔 Subscribe for more animated What If stories!

title: What If You Went Back 10 Years With All Your Memories?
description:
What if you woke up 10 years in the past, remembering everything about the future? 🧠⏳

You know Bitcoin is going to explode. You know exactly when the market will crash. And you have 10 years to turn that knowledge into millions.

Sounds like the easiest way to get rich, right? Well... not exactly. 💰

title: What If You Could See Everyone's Biggest Mistake?
description:
What if you could see everyone's biggest mistake floating above their head? 👀

One day, Alex discovers this strange ability. But when he meets a homeless man whose biggest mistake seems connected to him, everything changes.

Some mistakes can change your life forever... but what if you had a chance to fix them? 💔

Subscribe for more What If stories!

title: What If You Could See Everyone's Future Height?
description:
What if you could see how tall everyone will be in the future? 📏👀

Imagine being 21 years old and only 5'8", while your 6'0" best friend constantly makes fun of your height.

But one day, you discover something unbelievable: you're destined to become 6'3", while your friend will shrink to 5'11". 💀

Will growing taller finally change your life, or is there something more important than height?

title: What If You Could See Everyone's IQ?
description:
What if you could see everyone's IQ floating above their heads? 🧠👀

Imagine having a genius-level IQ of 160 but still failing your exams, while the smartest-looking student in class gets straight A's with only 70 IQ. 💀

But when the two compete to prove who's actually smarter, things take an unexpected turn.

Does having a higher IQ really make you smarter, or is there more to intelligence than just a number? 🤔

title: What If You Could See Everyone's Biggest Regret?
description:
What if you could see everyone's biggest regret floating above their heads? 👀💔

At first, it's hilarious. People regretting bad relationships, missed opportunities, and terrible decisions.

But everything changes when you look at your own father and see just two words above his head…

**MY SON.** 💔

Would you really want to know what the people closest to you regret most? 🥺

title: What If You Could See Winning Lottery Tickets?
description:
Imagine knowing which lottery tickets are winners before buying them. 🎟️💰

A few hundred dollars turns into thousands… until you spot a ticket worth $250 MILLION. There's just one problem: someone else is reaching for it first. 😳

Getting rich should be easy with this superpower, right? But what if the biggest jackpot comes with a price nobody can see?

Would you grab the ticket? 👀

title: What If You Could See How Many People Have a Crush on You?
description:
What if you could see exactly how many people have a crush on you? 👀❤️

Imagine being a handsome guy with 0 admirers… while a tall, awkward-looking guy has 999+ people crushing on him. 💀

But what happens when you discover that attraction isn't as simple as you thought?

Would you want to know your number? 🤔

title: What If You Could See How Many Partners Everyone Has Had?
description:
What if you could see exactly how many partners everyone has had? 👀

Imagine walking past an innocent-looking nun… only to see the number 78 floating above her head. 💀

From awkward encounters to shocking secrets, this superpower might reveal more than you ever wanted to know.

Would you want to see everyone's number? 🤔

title: What If You Could See Everyone's Future Wealth?
description:
What if you could see how rich everyone will become? 💰

Imagine walking past a homeless man, only to discover he's destined to become a billionaire. But what happens when you realize the future isn't guaranteed?

Would you use this power to get rich, or change someone's life? 👀

title: What If You Could See How Many Days People Have Left?
description: What if you could see exactly how many days everyone has left to live? ⏳ What starts as an incredible superpower quickly turns into a nightmare when you discover the terrifying price of saving someone.

title: What If You Could See 10 Seconds Into the Future?
description:
Watch a stick figure animation explore the complexities of a shared experience. This short film uses a simple magic trick to raise questions about empathy.

This animation follows a character in a blue hoodie performing a cup trick in various urban settings. Rather than a standard narrative, the piece focuses on how we perceive our surroundings and the people we encounter daily. It is a quiet study on how a brief interaction can shift our perspective on the world around us.

The video concludes by challenging viewers to consider the nature of a shared perception. By observing the stick figure navigate these spaces, we get a unique look at how empathy functions in a public environment. It serves as a reminder that even the smallest actions can connect us to others in unexpected ways.

Subscribe for weekly animation breakdowns, and let me know in the comments if this story changed how you view your own daily interactions.
